V. 31.
If they do theſe things in the green tree, what ſhall be done in the dry?—Our LORD makes Uſe of a proverbial Expreſſion, frequent among the Jews, who compare a good Man to a green Tree, and a bad Man to a dead one: As if he had ſaid, If an innocent Perſon ſuffer thus, what will become of the Wicked? Of thoſe who are as ••dy for Deſtruction, as dry Wood for the Fire?
